name: Chief of Staff
description: Runs your day: reminders, tasks with deadlines, shopping lists and notes you set in plain words, a morning brief with weather and calendar, and an evening wrap.

examples: remind me to call mom thursday 6pm
remind me in 2 hours to stretch

settings.label: Your city
settings.help: For the weather line in your morning brief. A city name, e.g. Hyderabad or Austin.

settings.label: Calendar iCal address
settings.help: Your calendar's secret iCal link (Google Calendar: Settings → your calendar → Secret address in iCal format). Starts with https:// (change webcal:// to https://).

settings.label: Evening wrap time
settings.help: When the evening wrap-up arrives, 24-hour HH:MM. Default 20:30.
